title: Unparalleled photocurrent and dark radical conversions of natural nano-iron oxides versus synthetic ones: thousand-fold enhanced degradation of extra antibiotic resistant genes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00188A, Paper
Yutong Meng, Daiye Fu, Jundie Ying, Xiangliang Pan
Natural nano-iron oxides have thousand-fold higher degradation of eARGs than the synthetic ones due to their unparalleled photocurrent and dark radical conversions.
